newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait premier leaves London hospital - agency.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait premier leaves London hospital - agency.

text.p: Kuwait's Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah was discharged from a London hospital on Monday after receiving medical treatment following a colon surgery in Kuwait earlier in March, the Kuwait News Agency said.

"His Highness the Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Salem al-Sabah left the London Clinic today (Monday) morning following...medical checks," it quoted a statement from the emiri court.
Sheikh Saad, born 1930, would stay in a London suburb residence for recuperation, it said.
Sheikh Saad, who has been prime minister and heir apparent since 1978, underwent a colon surgery at a Kuwait City hospital where he was admitted after fainting due to internal bleeding.
